newsitem.title: USA: Gradall workers strike, deliveries continue.
newsitem.headline: Gradall workers strike, deliveries continue.

text.p: The Gradall Co, a subsidiary of Gradall Industries Inc, said Tuesday that the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers have gone on strike.
The company said it obtained a temporary restraining order Monday to limit the number of pickets and allow shipments and deliveries to continue.
Local lodge No 1285 of the union began striking Sunday after failing to ratify a new three-year contract, the company said.

The strike affects about 430 hourly workers at the company's plant in Philadelphia, Ohio, said Chief Financial Officer Bruce Jonker. The plant makes hydraulic excavators and rough terrain material handlers and has a total of 640 employees.
Jonker said it is too early to determine the strike's impact on revenues and earnings. He said the plant is still handling limited production and shipping product.
"There might not be any impact on the earnings. At this point in time, there is no impact on earnings," Jonker said.
